en.title: Sell a course as one booking
en.body: A course is a fixed set of lessons with a start and an end, like a beginner block or a term. Members enrol once and keep their place in every lesson, and the studio sells the places rather than each session.

fr.title: Vendre un cours en une seule réservation

it.title: Vendi un corso con una sola prenotazione
